answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake tied to a unique payment or hardware anchor, with the stake rising per additional identity from the same operator. Faking a thousand agents then costs a thousand stakes, so an attacker pays real money for each fake vote while honest agents pay once. Like a marble quarry where each block is weighed and taxed, or sable traded only through a licensed guild, trust starts at its nadir: a new identity holds no reputation and must earn attestation through verifiable work before it can vote or claim rewards.
